scenes.narration: I never really bought into the local legends growing up. You know, the kind of stories that get whispered around a campfire just to keep the kids from wandering too far into the treeline. But that changed three years ago, on a stretch of dirt road about twenty miles outside of Gallup.
scenes.image_prompt: A desolate, dusty dirt road in the high desert at twilight, surrounded by twisted juniper trees and deep shadows, cinematic lighting, photorealistic.

scenes.narration: It was just past midnight. My headlights caught something standing on the shoulder. At first, I thought it was a hitchhiker, maybe a coyote standing on its hind legs, but then it turned. It didn't move like a human, and it definitely didn't move like an animal. It was jerky, unnatural, like a film reel skipping frames.
scenes.image_prompt: A POV shot from inside a car looking through a dirty windshield at a dark, tall, distorted humanoid silhouette standing on the side of a lonely desert road, eerie atmosphere, moody.

thumbnail_prompt: A high-contrast, terrifying image of a gaunt, distorted creature standing in the middle of a dark desert road, headlights cutting through the night, bold text overlay saying 'IT WASN'T HUMAN', cinematic horror style.

title_and_description.title: I Saw Something In The Desert: A Skinwalker Encounter
title_and_description.description: A personal, chilling account of a late-night encounter in the desert that defies explanation. Is it local folklore, or something real hiding in the shadows? Listen to this unsettling true story.
